Chapter 6802: Gu Chun’S Rules

Chapter 6802: Gu Chun’s Rules

This world made everyone want to leave. Unfortunately, the inhabitants could not do so. Their destiny was either to be devoured or become a part of the darkness. They never saw the light since birth.

However, life was stubborn and miraculous. A few lucky continents struggled in the darkness.

Li Qiye looked around and saw a golden light - a speck of sand among an ocean of darkness. He took one step and arrived instantly.

This turned out to be a continent known as Golden Lamp Everlasting Ground - a place still untouched by darkness.

This wasn’t due to the presence of a powerful immortal. Just something here was indelible. In Heavenrealm, many believed that this was the right place to polish one’s dao heart.

Legend has it that the resistance was fierce. Golden Immortal and his followers fought bravely until they could hold on no longer.

At the last second before death, Golden Immortal lit up his dao heart and left behind a mantra, forever illuminating one continent.

His death proved his determination and empowered his dao heart. Thus, Mang was not being merciful when sparing it. Nothing could move this light.

The devourers gave up and from then on, Golden Lamp Everlasting Ground became the continent’s name.

Where Mang failed, time tried again. As the ages passed, the darkness slowly corroded this light.

It wasn’t until the new blessing of the Enlightener that this place became bright again. Li Baye planted his primordial tree right on this continent, giving it strength.

Subsequently, a heavenly woman with a river of time descended in Golden Lamp Everlasting Ground. She visited the dao heart and lit it up again on her river. Just like that, it became brighter and more fortified.

In the present, it has reached its prime with a high population. Of course, it couldn’t compare to the major worlds such as Epoch Dawn or Grand Thousand.

“This place...” Li Qiye carefully sensed it, especially the indestructible power of the dao heart.

Alas, Golden Immortal had died and he was its source. It persevered until now with the help of the primordial influx and the power of time. The latter was beyond the temporal affinity; it was a perfect fusion of time and the dao heart.

Li Qiye couldn’t help but smile after sensing the immaculate fusion taking root beneath the land.

He looked around again and located Tinyleaf City.

“Right here.” He visited only to find the city in trouble.

“Ahhh!” Screams echoed due to a battle.

“Defend the city!” Cultivators tried to defend against a horde of monsters and demons.

“Rumble!” Thrown boulders pierced the walls, allowing demons to leap inside.

“Frenzy City, are you breaking the Law of Gu Chun?!” Tinyleaf City Lord shouted.

He was an old man in the king cultivation realm. He fought against ten demons by himself using a heavy sword. Alas, the horde pushed him back.

“Hahaha, the law only forbids devouring, we are only killing!” A golden eagle appeared; its wings illuminated the city.

Immortal Emperor Gu Chun was the supreme lord of Stygian after Zhao Dachui’s death. He forbade anyone from devouring those weaker than the overlord realm.

To go against him meant facing the wrath of Gu Chun’s Dark Realm - an absolute death sentence. This was the strongest lineage in Devouring Alliance.

Thus, his law has been carried out for eras now without exception.

“The law does not apply here. Surrender your city and you may survive.” The eagle laughed.
